findings.description: Lines 17-24 hardcode a developer macOS contract path. On clean Linux checkout unit: exit 1, 151 passed/13 failed; full: exit 1, 247 passed/13 failed. Use portable frozen input or self-contained fixtures; do not recreate developer filesystem paths to hide this.

Lines 54-56,111-127 omit ignored controlled files and include nonignored fixed artifact files. Derive controlled inventory from tracked plus all untracked with only trusted fixed artifact exclusions; tracked artifacts remain controlled.

Lines 117,125 derive deleted from current index rather than supplied baseline. git rm a baseline file produces deleted=[]; derive baseline file inventory from baseline_commit, preserving staged/index deletions.

Lines 88-123 check only leaf links and hash without identity/size/mtime/inventory rechecks. With an ignored symlink directory replacing tracked sub/, capture hashes outside-root sub/x. Mutation immediately after hash is accepted. Reject ancestor links and observed file/inventory mutation; do not claim OS sandbox.

Lines 28-33 accept any Git subdirectory as actual root; lines 129-132 inspect excluded .venv symlinks before exclusion and reject a normal valid uv environment. No LFS pointer/submodule checks exist. Verify actual repository root, exclude only untracked fixed artifacts first, and reject unsupported tracked formats and unsupported platform capabilities.

Lines 58-67 compile ** as .* between mandatory slashes. **/*.py misses root x.py and src/**/x.py misses src/x.py. A forbidden **/*.py therefore permits forbidden root changes. Implement whole-segment globstar matching zero or more directories.

Lines 17-40 accept rehashed snapshots with schema_version=true, invalid mode/hash, duplicate or casefold-colliding paths, unsorted entries and contradictory inventories. Dictionary conversion lines 107-110 silently collapses duplicates. Strictly validate all snapshot structure and digest types before policy decisions; snapshot._validate_expected also produces AttributeError for int paths rather than ValueError.

Lines 347-390 copy only five required files and silently discard extra source files. Lines 218-219 reject ordinary nested directories as hardlinks because directories normally have nlink>1; lines 465-466 reject valid nested manifest paths using ID regex. Preserve every regular input file with canonical relative paths and include all output bytes in manifest; do not treat directory nlink as regular-file hardlink.

Lines 353-387 hash source and later reread for output with no capture consistency check. Deterministic source mutation returns a successful freeze whose verify immediately fails. Line 246 only checks immediate output parent; linked/sub/output writes through symlink ancestor. Lines 397-398 os.replace can replace an output created after precheck. Reject ancestry links and observed source mutation, and never overwrite concurrent pre-existing output.

Lines 134-140 reject schema-valid max_repair_rounds/max_takeovers=0. Lines 179-181 accept ../escape patterns. schema_version=true accepted by equality checks; verification bool schemas likewise. Missing task in trusted canonical manifest leaks FileNotFoundError. Enforce exact schema v1, valid pattern syntax, SHA256 length64 and required manifest inventory; normalize invalid input to ValueError.

Lines 79-102 inspect sidecars after sqlite connect, skip dangling symlinks via exists(), and explicitly check nlink only when suffix==empty. A hardlinked -journal is accepted; lines 152-155 check only immediate parent, allowing ancestor link writes. Validate DB and all sidecars/ancestors before SQLite consumes them, rejecting ordinary-file hardlinks and dangling symlinks.

Line 53 falsely records pytest exit0 with 1 failed test; pytest test failures exit1, corroborated historical reviewer record. Lines 16/68 conflict on reviewer completion, line 56 stale prior code snapshot, line 34 stale line count. macOS 41/42 is an unresolved required failure, not cleared by this Linux 42/42 run. Correct real evidence and implement honest capability rejection where unsupported.
